canonical_definition:
What it is. Papers describe ImageNet-A as an out-of-distribution benchmark for ImageNet that contains natural adversarial examples and is challenging for standard models. Across the available definitions, that is the only characterization provided.

What it is claimed to measure. No papers link ImageNet-A to any construct or behavioral indicator, so the available literature here does not specify what it is claimed to measure.

Space of uses. The available evidence only shows the benchmark being named in Section 5.1 of "LiNeS: Post-training Layer Scaling Prevents Forgetting and Enhances Model Merging". No papers link it to any other measurement instrument, so its use alongside other benchmarks is not specified.
